name: Chaitra Navratri / Vasantha Navaratri Day 1: Shailaputri Puja

nameRegional.nameEnglish: Chaitra Navratri / Vasantha Navaratri Day 1: Shailaputri Puja
nameRegional.nameBengali: বাসন্তী পুজা প্রথম দিন - শৈলপুত্রী পূজা

purpose.description: Worship of Maa Shailaputri - Daughter of the Mountains
purpose.addtional_description: Nine nights of Goddess Durga worship (Spring). The first day of Navratri involves Ghatasthapana (Kalash Sthapana). Shailaputri represents strength and stability.

nameRegional.nameBengali: বাসন্তী পুজা দ্বিতীয় দিন - ব্রহ্মচারিণী পূজা

purpose.description: Worship of Maa Brahmacharini - Symbol of penance and knowledge
purpose.additional_description: She represents the ascetic form of Goddess Parvati and blesses devotees with wisdom and peace.

nameRegional.nameBengali: বাসন্তী পুজা তৃতীয় দিন - চন্দ্রঘণ্টা পূজা

purpose.description: Worship of Maa Chandraghanta - Destroyer of evil and negativity
purpose.additional_description: She has a half-moon on her forehead and represents bravery and courage.

nameRegional.nameBengali: বাসন্তী পুজা চতুর্থ দিন - কুষ্মাণ্ডা পূজা

purpose.description: Worship of Maa Kushmanda - The creator of the universe
purpose.additional_description: She is credited with creating the world with her divine smile and represents abundance and health.

nameRegional.nameBengali: বাসন্তী পুজা পঞ্চম দিন - স্কন্দমাতা পূজা

purpose.description: Worship of Maa Skandamata - Mother of Lord Kartikeya
purpose.additional_description: She symbolizes motherly love, protection, and the fulfillment of desires.

nameRegional.nameBengali: বাসন্তী পুজা ষষ্ঠ দিন - কাত্যায়নী পূজা

purpose.description: Worship of Maa Katyayani - Warrior form of Durga
purpose.additional_description: Goddess Katyayani is the fiercest warrior form who destroyed the demon Mahishasura.

steps: Worship for a successful marriage or career

nameRegional.nameBengali: বাসন্তী পুজা সপ্তম দিন - কালরাত্রি পূজা

purpose.description: Worship of Maa Kalaratri - Remover of darkness and fear
purpose.additional_description: She is the fiercest form of the Goddess, appearing with a dark complexion and disheveled hair to destroy ignorance.

steps: Worship for protection against negative energies

nameRegional.nameBengali: বাসন্তী পুজা অষ্টম দিন - মহাগৌরী পূজা

purpose.description: Worship of Maa Mahagauri - Embodiment of purity and peace
purpose.additional_description: Representing extreme beauty and purity, she is worshipped to purify the mind and soul. This day is often celebrated as Maha Ashtami.

name: Chaitra Navratri Day 9: Siddhidatri Puja & Ram Navami

purpose.description: Worship of Maa Siddhidatri and Celebration of Lord Rama's Birth
purpose.additional_description: The final day grants 'Siddhis' (spiritual powers). It also marks Ram Navami, celebrating the birth anniversary of Lord Rama.

Festival of wealth - Worship of Lord Dhanvantari
purpose.addtional_description: Dhanteras is the first day of five days long Diwali festivities. On the day of Dhantrayodashi, Goddess Lakshmi came out of the ocean during the churning of the Milky Sea. Hence, Goddess Lakshmi, along with Lord Kubera who is the God of wealth, is worshipped on the auspicious day of Trayodashi.

purpose.description: Krishna's victory over demon Narakasura
purpose.addtional_description: Narak Chaturdashi is the second day of five days long Diwali festivities. On the day of Narak Chaturdashi, Lord Krishna defeated demon Narakasura who was terrorizing the people of Kurukshetra. This festival celebrates the victory of good over evil.
